text: DuckDuckGo does not collect or share personal information. That is our privacy policy in a nutshell. We don't save your search history. We don't track you in or out of private browsing mode. We don't store any personal identifiers with your queries. We don't sell your personal information. We have never sold any personal information. Period. We limit data retention to the duration necessary for specific services. We do not knowingly market to or solicit information from children under 13.
notes: Clean privacy-first. Content ownership N/A (no user-content model).

text: Signal uses end-to-end encryption so that the contents of your messages are known only to you and your intended recipients. Signal does not have access to your messages, your profile, your avatar, your group metadata, who you are talking to, or who is in your contact list. We do not use your messages to train AI. Signal is a nonprofit and does not sell user data. We retain only the minimum data necessary: your phone number and the date you last connected to our service, rounded to the day. You may delete your account at any time.
notes: E2E means provider cannot train/sell/license content.

text: Proton uses zero-knowledge encryption. Your data is stored encrypted on our servers and we cannot read it, not even if we wanted to. We do not use your data or content to train AI models. We do not sell, share, or otherwise monetize your personal data. We retain account data only as long as your account is active. When you delete your account, all your data is permanently deleted within 14 days. Proton is a privacy-first service headquartered in Switzerland and subject to strict Swiss privacy laws.
notes: Zero-knowledge, explicit denials across the board.
